originals.why: Uses i'w yfed, not the LEGO i yfed. The same Korean would also give 'dw i isio rhywbeth i yfed', the form this seed teaches, so the prompt has two possible Welsh answers.

originals.why: The 'i' here belongs to 'mynd i' (going to), not to 'i yfed' meaning 'to drink' as in 'something to drink', so the LEGO is used in the wrong sense.
